algorithm.numeric_precision: IEEE-754 NumPy float64 throughout, population std ddof=0
algorithm.color_input: Full, unannotated PNG; alpha/transparency composited onto opaque white using Pillow; then RGB
algorithm.rgb: Pillow encoded RGB uint8 converted to float64 then divided by 255.0; no linear-light conversion

resize.aspect: preserve aspect to nearest integer pixel; no crop, stretch or padding

algorithm.gray: Y=(float64(0.299)*R + float64(0.587)*G) + float64(0.114)*B, in this operation order

gradient.edge: G > float64(0.08), strict; equality is not an edge
gradient.flat: G < float64(0.02), strict; equality is not flat

algorithm.grid: 3x3 tiles; y boundaries=floor(k*H/3), x=floor(k*W/3), k=0..3; each pixel covered once; empty tiles for H<3 or W<3 ignored; population std(tile edge densities)/(mean+1e-6); no edges=>0
algorithm.border: top/bottom ceil(H*0.10) rows, left/right ceil(W*0.10) columns, each at least 1; boolean union deduplicates corners; border edge count / all edge count; no edges=>0
algorithm.projection: row/column edge counts are weights; y=i/(H-1), x=j/(W-1); singleton axis coordinate=0; weighted population std on [0,1]; no edges=>0

features.grid_edge_cv: population std(nonempty tile edge densities)/(mean+1e-6); no edges=>0
features.border_edge_ratio: edge pixels in outer-10% boolean-union mask / total edge pixels; zero total=>0
features.horizontal_projection_spread: weighted std of normalized row positions, weighted by row edge count
features.vertical_projection_spread: weighted std of normalized column positions, weighted by column edge count

inputs.reference_sha_index: features/feature_index.csv; identity/hash metadata only; no .npy read
inputs.raw_png_validation: all 1840 signatures, SHA256 against prior index, Pillow full decoding and metadata dimensions passed

source_type_use: diagnostics only; absent from numeric feature matrix and core function
serialization: CSV UTF-8 LF; 17 significant digits, binary64 exact round trip; row order=numeric slide_id
scope_guards: runtime audit hook blocks annotations, descriptions, all .npy/.npz/.joblib, and test/excluded raw PNGs
payload_hash_definition: canonical_sha256 of this JSON object after removing only payload_sha256
